questions.q: The proverb 'Too many cooks spoil the broth.' means—
o: you get the results of your own actions
a true friend helps in times of trouble
people of similar character keep company
too many people working on a task can ruin it

questions.q: Choose the correct translation: 'সে গতকাল থেকে জ্বরে ভুগছে।'
